a.lede: Apple’s first folding phone is inspiring indie developers to create fun, quirky apps that take advantage of the screen and the hinge. Here are a few to try as you explore the Duo.
a.title: 9 Unique Apps to Try on the iPhone Duo

b.lede: From retro cassette players and virtual notebooks to flight trackers and even a digital toaster, developers are finding creative ways to take advantage of Apple's first foldable iPhone.
b.title: These clever apps show off the iPhone Duo’s potential
